market_wrap: Nifty rose 1.12% to 25,801 and the Sensex gained about 898 points for a second straight up day, led by private and PSU banks as foreign funds turned buyers; India held up while Asian markets slumped on a global sell-off in AI stocks, helped by softer crude. Breadth was weak, though: the Nifty Smallcap 100 slipped 0.13%. Your stocks and ETFs fell 2.7% (about ₹2,541) because gold and silver crashed again on US rate-hike bets; mutual-fund NAVs for today are not out yet, so fund values are unchanged.
